svg.title: Split Field: the perimeter after (Split Field 2)
svg.desc: The floodlit perimeter after, in ink line and Craftint tone: the chain fence on concrete posts, a floodlight mast with its lamps, a barricade of barriers, the plinth's gate with cracked glass above it, a banner pole down in the road and shields left on the ground. Ten numbered marks on objects; nobody is in the picture.
